editor.eyebrow: FROM A PLACE TO A POSSIBILITY
editor.title: Make room for a new beginning.
editor.subtitle: Keep the details clear. Place the pin carefully. Publish on your terms.
editor.essentials_body: Help students understand the space, the address and what living here is like.
editor.rent_capacity_body: Show exactly what the monthly price covers. Available beds are tracked by the system.
editor.occupancy_note: {occupied} occupied beds are recorded. Capacity cannot be reduced below this number.
editor.location_body: Choose the property entrance, not the nearest university. The exact pin will be public when you publish.
editor.universities_body: Estimated walking routes within 10 km, from the property to the supplied university reference pins. These are not verified entrances or live directions.
editor.no_routes: No usable walking route within 10 km is available for this pin. It will not appear in a university search without a matching route.
editor.pin_review: Some pins could not be matched near a mapped walking path. Review the property entrance; a university reference pin may also need team review. No distance is invented for these connections.
editor.routes_after_save: Save this pin, then calculate its university connections. Unknown distances are never shown as walking estimates.
editor.visibility_body: A draft is private. A published property can be found by students once its walking connections are available.
editor.publish_notice: Publishing makes your property details and exact map pin publicly readable. Walking distances are estimates to university reference pins. A listing without a usable route will not appear in that university's results.
editor.save_before_publish: Save your latest details and choose a map pin before publishing. Archiving does not cancel existing bookings.
editor.draft_hint: Changes stay here until you save

landlord.empty_body: New requests for your published properties appear here. Choose another status to review earlier decisions.

request.title: Request a bed
request.existing: You already have a request here.
request.price_notice: This is the current advertised rent. The server records the latest rent and currency when you send your request; that quote is kept in your request history.
request.room_notice: Select one available type before sending. The price is for one bed, not the whole room. Full types cannot be selected.
request.message_notice: Optional. Only the property owner can review this message with your request. Avoid sensitive personal information.
request.message_hint: Introduce yourself or ask about the place.
request.unavailable: This place cannot take a new request
request.no_payment: No payment is taken here. Sending a request does not confirm accommodation.
request.leave_draft: Your request has not been sent. Leaving discards your message and room choice, or you can stay and finish it.
request.leave_uncertain: Your request may already have reached the server. Leaving does not cancel it. Check the Requests tab before starting another request.

detail.title: Booking request
detail.quote_notice: This is the original quote, not today's listing price or a payment receipt.
detail.snapshot_beds: At submission: {available} of {total} beds were available. This is not the current availability.
detail.privacy: This request shares the message, not private profile details or lifestyle answers. Compatibility results are not available yet.
detail.no_message: No message was added to this request.
detail.review_notice: Only acceptance reserves a bed. The server checks capacity again before recording your decision.
detail.cancel_accepted_notice: Cancelling an accepted booking releases its bed. This cannot be undone; you would need to send a new request.
detail.cancel_pending_notice: You can cancel while waiting. A pending request has not reserved a bed.

explanation.pending: Your request is waiting for landlord review. No bed is reserved yet.
explanation.accepted: The landlord accepted this request. One bed is recorded for this booking. Payments and move-in arrangements are not handled in the app.
explanation.rejected: The landlord declined this request. No bed is reserved by it. You can explore other homes or send a new request later.
explanation.cancelled: This request was cancelled. It no longer holds a bed.

confirm.accept_body: This reserves one bed at the request's original quoted rent. Acceptance can fail if the last bed was taken or the property is no longer published.
confirm.reject_body: The student will see your decision. No bed is reserved and this request will be closed.
confirm.cancel_body: This closes your pending request. If the landlord accepts it before cancellation finishes, cancellation also releases that bed.
confirm.cancel_accepted_body: This cancels your accepted booking and releases its bed. The action cannot be undone. A new request would need the landlord's approval again.

feedback.accepted: Request accepted. The server recorded one occupied bed.
feedback.rejected: Request declined. No availability was consumed.
feedback.cancelled: Request cancelled. Any bed held by this booking was released.

errors.session_changed: Your session changed. Sign in again before continuing.

errors.integrity: The server could not safely update bed availability. Nothing was changed. Contact the project administrator before retrying.

errors.invalid_response: We could not safely read the booking data. Check the latest status before taking another action.

errors.write_uncertain: We could not confirm the server's response. The action may have succeeded. Check the latest status or retry the exact same action; no duplicate request will be created.

student_quiz.subtitle: This quiz is optional. Choose one answer in each of the five categories to finish, or skip with partial or no answers.

student_quiz.guests_prompt: What overnight guest policy do you prefer?
student_quiz.room_prompt: How flexible are you about the room layout?
student_quiz.privacy_notice: Save sends your chosen answers to your private account. Skip and save progress also saves partial answers, leaving the rest unanswered. Changes stay on this screen until a save succeeds; no background uploads or compatibility scores.
student_quiz.answer_all_required: Choose one answer in each of the five categories to finish, or use Skip and save progress.
student_quiz.discard_body: Your latest selections are not saved to your account. Discard them or keep editing. Any older device-only copy is kept.
student_quiz.load_error_title: Could not load your saved answers

student_quiz.save_error: Could not save your answers. Your selections are still here; please try again.
student_quiz.conflict: Your answers changed on another device. Your selections are still here. Reload the latest answers before saving again.
student_quiz.request_failed: We could not confirm the request. Your selections are still here. Reload to check whether your last save reached your account before trying again.
student_quiz.session_changed: Your session changed or cannot access these answers. Sign in to your student account again.
student_quiz.setup_required: Preference sync is not configured yet. Run supabase/005_lifestyle_sync.sql, then retry.
student_quiz.invalid_response: We could not safely read the saved answers. Nothing has been overwritten. Reload the latest answers before saving.

student_quiz.review_local: You have an older device-only draft. Open the quiz to review it before saving or skipping online.
